breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction, stating 'Employ a gamma‑centered Monkhorst‑Pack k‑point grid generated automatically with a half‑grid shift.' This repeats the original error by combining a gamma-centered grid with a half-shift, which are contradictory. The ground truth resolves this by only specifying a gamma-centered k-point grid, without any mention of a half shift.
